senses.gloss: m. pl. (σεβαστοί) members of the imperial family, princes. Tanḥ. B’midb. 2 [read:] הרבצתי אתכם כס׳ וכ׳ I caused you to recline on couches like princes; (ref. to ויסב, Ex. XIII, 8) כדרך שהמלכים מסובין וכ׳ just as kings recline; [Var. בסיגמטין, בסוג׳, taken fr.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1">Num. R. s. 1</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="O00562"><he>סִיגְמָטִין</he></cite>].
